audience: fitness studios and gyms that run classes and memberships in TeamUp

useCases.title: See who is booked into classes and how full they are
useCases.text: The AI lists classes and appointments in a time window with capacity, attending and waitlist counts, and lists the bookings (attendances) for an event.

useCases.title: Find memberships that are on hold or cancelled
useCases.text: The AI lists customer memberships filtered by status, such as hold or cancelled, with start, expiration and renewal dates. It can read the usage and next bill of one membership.

useCases.title: Find unpaid or failed invoices
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices by status with due date, amount due and payer, and reads the line items and charges of one invoice.

useCases.title: Book, remove or check in a customer for a class
useCases.text: The AI registers a customer for a class or appointment, cancels a booking, or confirms that the customer attended.

useCases.title: Look up or invite a customer
useCases.text: The AI searches customers (members and leads) by name or email and reads one customer. It can add a new customer, with or without an invitation email.

useCases.title: Read or log CRM interactions with a customer
useCases.text: The AI lists logged calls, emails and meetings for a customer, and records a new interaction with a note. This needs a super_admin-level token.
